aprs.title: APRS
aprs.summary: Native software Bell 202 receive and packet browser. Working on FD6818B hardware; reception performance can still be improved.

aprs-gps-sync.title: GPS Sync
aprs-gps-sync.summary: One-shot direct APRS position import from AG7SU-7 into native radio settings. Working on FD6818B hardware; requires API 23.

aprs-beacon.title: APRS Beacon
aprs-beacon.summary: Manually confirmed AX.25 position beacon using radio settings. Working on FD6818B hardware.

aprs-kiss-rx.title: APRS KISS RX
aprs-kiss-rx.summary: Receive-only KISS serial bridge; physical UART validation pending.

cardlink.title: Card Link
cardlink.summary: PixelQSO card transfers: original fixed-frame version hardware tested; API 24 native FSK migration awaits RF validation. Requires Data.

explore_scan.title: Explore Scan
explore_scan.summary: Compact repeater scanning and ranking; automatic advanced decoding and saving are not ported.

surf.title: SURF
surf.summary: Band spectrum and VFO B handoff; compact arena leaves limited scratch.

gw.title: Groundwave
gw.summary: Compact local two-player artillery game working on FD6818B hardware. Legacy RF multiplayer still requires a separate Data transport port.

rflimits.title: RF Limits
rflimits.summary: Receive-only tuning/RSSI diagnostic; not proof of PLL lock or RF coverage.

rfbaseb.title: RF IF B
rfbaseb.summary: FD6818B IF/GP0 capture diagnostic; use a steady reference carrier.

rffskrx.title: RF FSK RX
rffskrx.summary: Managed fixed-frame raw FIFO diagnostic; no validated APRS decoding.

rffsktx.title: RF FSK TX
rffsktx.summary: Low-power, manually confirmed test frame; dummy load only. RF validation pending.

aisclk.title: AIS Clock
aisclk.summary: Legacy FD6818 IF tap and timing; FD6818B port not validated.

aisships.title: AIS Ships
aisships.summary: Legacy FD6818 IF capture; FD6818B port not validated.

alarm.title: Alarm
alarm.summary: Requires a provisioned UTC clock and configured alarm; default bundle refuses to run.

clkget.title: Clock
clkget.summary: Clock diagnostic; requires an existing clock fix for meaningful results.

cwkey.title: CW Key
cwkey.summary: Legacy direct RF TX and baked-in bench frequency/callsign. Must be ported and configured before use.

cwlisten.title: CW Listen
cwlisten.summary: Legacy direct FD6818 tone detector; use managed Scan decoder when ported.

dmrrx.title: DMR RX
dmrrx.summary: Legacy capture pipeline; only about 1 KiB compact scratch remains before alignment. FD6818B port and memory audit required.

ft8rx.title: FT8 RX
ft8rx.summary: Legacy IF DMA/mixer path; about 1.2 KiB compact scratch remains. FD6818B port and RAM audit required.

ft8tx.title: FT8 TX
ft8tx.summary: Legacy FM audio FSK, baked-in bench frequency and callsign; not standard FT8 RF modulation.

midi.title: MIDI
midi.summary: Local speaker music player, working on FD6818B hardware.

morse.title: Morse
morse.summary: MCW paddle TX uses direct legacy RF tone registers; FD6818B transmit port and physical validation needed.

pocsag.title: POCSAG
pocsag.summary: Legacy FD6818 raw FSK register path; FD6818B port required.

rangerx.title: Range RX
rangerx.summary: Legacy raw FSK sign sampler; FD6818B Data port required.

rangetx.title: Range TX
rangetx.summary: Legacy direct FFSK TX and baked-in bench settings. Port and configuration required.

rtls.title: Station List
rtls.summary: Legacy repeater table diagnostic; mount may repair/write storage. Current host storage integration not validated.

rxmap.title: RX Map
rxmap.summary: Receive-only RSSI mapping bench utility; verify FD6818B tuning and measurements.

samerx.title: SAME RX
samerx.summary: Legacy raw FSK audio sampler; FD6818B port required. Not a dependable weather alert receiver.

stockfont.title: Stock Font
stockfont.summary: Read-only stock font probe; depends on intact factory SPI font data.

wsprbcn.title: WSPR Beacon
wsprbcn.summary: Legacy periodic FM FSK transmit with baked-in station identity; not standard WSPR RF modulation.

wspriq.title: WSPR IQ
wspriq.summary: Legacy IF capture and serial streaming; FD6818B port required.

wsprtx.title: WSPR TX
wsprtx.summary: Legacy FM FSK transmit with baked-in station identity; not standard WSPR RF modulation.
